title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten officially listed, no-fee Moon Township activities near Robert Morris University.

cards.entity_name: Friday Fly By Concert in the Park
cards.title: Hear Nathan King at Moon Park
cards.subtitle: Moon Park Amphitheater • Moon Township
cards.notes: Meet friends at the amphitheater for the township’s listed Friday Fly By concert. Food vendors are optional, so skip them to keep the hang free.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor concert with optional vendors nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Township lists the August 7 Friday Fly By Concert in the Park with Nathan King at Moon Park Amphitheater and a FREE fee.
cards.access_notes: Township listing marks the event FREE; food and beverage vendors are on-site but optional.

cards.entity_name: Movies in the Moonlight: E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial
cards.title: Catch E.T. after dusk
cards.subtitle: Moon Park Amphitheater • Moon Township
cards.notes: Bring a blanket or chair and settle in after dusk for the township’s outdoor screening. Pack your own snacks if you want to spend nothing.
cards.short_summary: A no-fee outdoor movie night at the amphitheater.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Township lists Movies in the Moonlight: E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial at Moon Park Amphitheater on August 21 with a FREE fee.
cards.access_notes: Township listing marks the screening FREE; scheduled for dusk, approximately 8:30 p.m.

cards.title: Watch the Animal Show
cards.subtitle: Moon Park Amphitheater • Moon Township
cards.notes: Join the early-evening Animal Show at the amphitheater with classmates, younger siblings, or visiting family—no ticket purchase is listed.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Township lists its Children's Amphitheater Event, an Animal Show at Moon Park Amphitheater, with a FREE fee.
cards.access_notes: Township listing marks the event FREE and gives a 6 p.m. start.

cards.entity_name: Robin Hill Lunchtime Concert: Kevin Solecki
cards.title: Take a lunch-break concert walk
cards.subtitle: Robin Hill Park • Moon Township
cards.notes: Head to Robin Hill Park for Kevin Solecki’s lunchtime accordion set. Bring lunch from home or simply listen and walk the grounds.
cards.short_summary: A free midday concert in Robin Hill Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Township lists a Robin Hill Lunchtime Concert by Kevin Solecki at Robin Hill Park on August 19 with a FREE fee.
cards.access_notes: Township listing marks the concert FREE; listed time is noon to 1 p.m.

cards.entity_name: Children's Amphitheater Event: Eyes on the Sky
cards.title: Learn storm-spotting outdoors
cards.subtitle: Moon Park Amphitheater • Moon Township
cards.notes: Meet up for Eyes on the Sky: Become a Storm Spotter, then make an evening stroll through Moon Park part of the outing.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor educational program at Moon Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Township lists Eyes on the Sky: Become a Storm Spotter as a Children's Amphitheater Event at Moon Park with a FREE fee.
cards.access_notes: Township listing marks the event FREE and gives a 6 p.m. start.

cards.entity_name: Robin Hill Lunchtime Concert: Doo Wop Drs
cards.title: Listen to the Doo Wop Drs
cards.subtitle: Robin Hill Park • Moon Township
cards.notes: Plan a midday break at Robin Hill Park for the Doo Wop Drs concert. The listing identifies it as free, with no purchase required.
cards.short_summary: A no-fee lunchtime concert in a named township park.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Township lists a Robin Hill Lunchtime Concert by the Doo Wop Drs at Robin Hill Park on September 16 with a FREE fee.
cards.access_notes: Township listing marks the concert FREE; listed time is noon to 1 p.m.

cards.title: See Casper under the sky
cards.subtitle: Moon Park Amphitheater • Moon Township
cards.notes: Make a low-key fall plan around the listed outdoor Casper screening. Bring a seat and snacks from home to preserve the zero-dollar plan.
cards.short_summary: A free fall movie screening at the Moon Park Amphitheater.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Township lists Movies in the Moonlight: Casper at Moon Park Amphitheater on October 2 with a FREE fee.
cards.access_notes: Township listing marks the screening FREE; scheduled for dusk, approximately 7:30 p.m.

cards.title: Get close to working vehicles
cards.subtitle: Moon Park • Moon Township
cards.notes: Walk through the vehicle displays, talk with their operators, and take photos at this township event. Food trucks are present but not required.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Township’s Touch A Truck listing says attendance is free and invites visitors to see vehicles and talk with the people who use them.
cards.access_notes: Official listing says “Free to attend”; it notes food trucks on site, which are optional.

cards.title: Join Moon Township Earth Day
cards.subtitle: Robin Hill Park • Moon Township
cards.notes: Use the afternoon to browse the listed vendors and activities at Robin Hill Park. The township identifies the event itself as free.
cards.short_summary: A free township environmental event with vendors and activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Township lists its Earth Day event at Robin Hill Park with a Free cost and says it includes vendors and activities.
cards.access_notes: Official calendar lists the cost as Free; individual vendor offerings are not represented as free.

cards.title: Drive through Moon’s holiday lights
cards.subtitle: Moon Park • Moon Township
cards.notes: Coordinate a carpool for the township’s nighttime lights route through Moon Park. Viewing is listed as free; bring only what you need.
cards.short_summary: A free seasonal drive-through light display.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Township describes the Moon Holiday Lights Drive-Thru at Moon Park as FREE and lists nightly hours from 5 to 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Moon Township Moon Holiday Lights Drive-Thru
cards.access_notes: Official calendar lists the fee as Free and identifies the program as a drive-through; verify the current season’s dates before going.

warnings: Several official township listings are date-specific 2026 events; confirm dates before making plans. Optional food vendors are not included in the free-cost claim.
